**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: APPROVED**

**Service:** Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (CPT 43644)  
**Order Date:** June 15, 2025  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]

---

Your prior authorization request for laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass has been **APPROVED**. The patient meets all medical necessity criteria.

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement:** Patient's BMI is 45.4 kg/m² (measured June 6, 2025), exceeding the required minimum of 35 kg/m².

**Obesity-Related Comorbidities:** Patient has documented essential hypertension (active since October 2017) and type 2 diabetes mellitus (documented January 2025), both obesity-related conditions.

**Prior Conservative Treatment:** Patient completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Net weight loss was 2 kg, which was regained after discontinuation. The treating physician documented this as unsuccessful.

**Covered Procedure:** Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass is a covered bariatric procedure.

Authorization is valid for 60 days from this letter. Please contact us if you have questions.
